note: What a client sends to tell a server what it wants a unit to do. The path it carries is what the client would take; where the unit actually goes is whatever the server answers with. The header names the sender's champion.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What the order is.

fields.name: targetX
fields.note: Where the order points, along one ground axis. Carried in world units rather than in the units a path uses.

fields.name: targetY
fields.note: The height of the place ordered.

fields.name: targetZ
fields.note: Where the order points, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: target
fields.note: The network object the order is aimed at, or zero where it is aimed at open ground.

fields.name: movement
fields.note: Every point after the first.

revisions.note: What a client sends as its player gives an order. The header names the unit ordered: the player's champion, or a unit it controls alongside, which gets its own copy of the order.
